title: The Silver Leaf band and its members
summary: Murray recalls the Silver Leaf jazz band with guitarist Joe Nickerson and violinist Albert Batiste; he cannot recall others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What about the Silver Leaf band? I ain't mentioned that.

Well they played jazz. They played jazz? Oh yeah, Silver Leaf band, yeah. A fella by the name of Joe Nickerson, he was the late, Joe Nickerson was the guitar player in that band. And Albert Batiste was the violin player. Old man Batiste, he's passed up. But nearly all of them is there. That's none of them living.
Do you remember the other guys in the band?
No, that's all I can remember right at the present time. See? That's all I can remember of them.
